title: Optoelectronic Devices
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in ENEE205, ENEE222, and ENEE245; and minimum grade of C- in ENEE322 or ENEE323.
Recommended: A background in semiconductors and P-N junctions.
Restriction: Must be in one of the following programs (Engineering: Computer; Engineering: Electrical); and permission of the Electrical and Computer Engineering Department.
Credit only granted for: ENEE484 or ENEE489I.
Formerly: ENEE489I.
